start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my task pages on this computer". It opens http://127.0.0.1:<this computer's door port>/pages/tool:serve-the-task-pages/index.html?dbs=<the database whose task_pages names your pursuits>,<each pursuit's database>&pages=<the first>, you sign in once with your own sign-in, and the page shows Now and History for the pursuits you pick, read from their databases each time it asks.
no_lists_because: It reads your databases' task tables (task_pages and each pursuit's calendar_tasks, task_changes, task_statuses, task_shows, task_facts, task_fact_kinds) and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Each pursuit with a task page is a row of task_pages (pursuit, label, database, tables, place) in one of your databases.
2. Open the page at this computer's door: /pages/tool:serve-the-task-pages/index.html?dbs=<names>&pages=<the task_pages database>. The door serves it on its loopback address only.

3. Sign in when it asks; the page then calls this tool through the door (do_one_thing_in_my_account, method tools:run, with call pursuits or data and input {dbs}) every few seconds while its tab is visible.
